note: Scripture authority is the 1962 Amharic Bible (UBS; NT revised 2003). Its New Testament is on disk whole (ebible mirror gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/amh_amh; re-verified for this job: the NT books return 200, the OT books 404). OT quotations reuse the wording of an already-shipped Amharic work where one quotes the same verse (source_file names it) and are otherwise self_rendered in the 1962 register.

A `mined` row was re-measured against the finished text: an exact substring of at least 20 characters of the 1962 NT verse (or of the cited corpus file) inside that block. Shorter quotations are self_rendered even when worded as the 1962 text (John 21:22b, «ምን አግዶህ? አንተ ተከተለኝ»). The English quotes the KJV; per the Amharic teens editions each chapter epigraph cites book and verse with no version label. Luke 9:23 sits inside the mirror's bridged LUK 9:21-23 entry, whose text after «ለሁሉም እንዲህ አላቸው።» is verse 23 whole, so it is quoted from there. Ecclesiastes 1:2 (no shipped Amharic work quotes the whole verse; the corpus's short form «ከንቱ ከንቱ ሁሉ ከንቱ ነው» is in against-eutropius.am.json) and Proverbs 29:25 (no shipped rendering) are self_rendered.

Thomas's own sentences, and the two verses he quotes in chapter 1 (John 8:12, Ecclesiastes 1:8), are pasted from the shipped full edition, the-imitation-of-christ.am.json, cut only where the English cuts, so the full ⇄ teens cross-link reads as one book. Its John 8:12 is the verse's second half in full (it includes «የሕይወት ብርሃን ይሆንለታል», which the teen English quote omits); kept as the full edition has it. Chapter 3 keeps that edition's «ለምንድር» (likely a typo for «ለምንድን») verbatim; a reviewer fixing it should fix both editions.
